headline: Senior Finance Operations Manager | Fintech & Digital Payments Expert
summary: Accomplished finance professional with over 12 years of experience within Nepal's banking and digital payment ecosystems. Expert in managing large-scale financial reconciliations, ensuring NRB regulatory compliance, and optimizing treasury operations. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in high-growth fintech environments and traditional banking sectors.

experiences.title: Head of Finance Operations
description: Oversee daily financial operations and settlement processes for Nepal's largest digital wallet, handling millions of transactions monthly.
Lead the reconciliation team to ensure 100% accuracy in merchant settlements and bank-link transfers.
Coordinate directly with Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) for regulatory reporting and compliance with Payment Service Provider (PSP) bylaws.
Implemented an automated reconciliation tool that reduced manual processing time by 40%.
Manage liquidity and treasury functions to ensure sufficient float for real-time customer withdrawals and utility payments.

experiences.title: Operations Manager
description: Managed branch-level operations and back-office financial controls for one of Nepal's leading commercial banks.
Supervised a team of 15 staff across customer service, cash management, and credit administration departments.
Ensured strict adherence to AML/CFT guidelines and internal audit protocols.
Streamlined inter-branch reconciliation processes, significantly reducing outstanding entries.
Facilitated the integration of financial systems during the bank's merger and acquisition phase.

experiences.title: Finance Officer
description: Performed daily accounting tasks including general ledger maintenance and monthly financial closures.
Assisted in the preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with NFRS (Nepal Financial Reporting Standards).
Managed tax filings and VAT reconciliations for the corporate office.
Handled payroll administration and employee benefit fund accounting.
